tasks.title: Build AI Trading System
tasks.why: Build a regime-aware ensemble trading system for ETHUSDT 5m. Not a single strategy — a competitive ecosystem of 300 evidence-based strategies scored across 6 market regimes (Strong Greed, Greed, Neutral, Fear, Strong Fear, Extreme Fear), continuously competing for allocation. Architecture: Meta-Regime Filter → Confidence Engine (all strategies vote) → Dynamic Lineup (20 Active + 10 Bench, monthly promotion/demotion). Every strategy tested across ALL 6 regimes. Rankings and weights change per regime, but the strategy universe stays the same. No culling until all 300 strategies have completed backtests.
tasks.nextAction: Build the strategy research tracker — 300 evidence-based strategy concepts from GitHub, YouTube, X, and academic papers, scored for evidence quality and diversity across 7 edge classes (Trend, Momentum, Breakout, Mean Reversion, Volatility, Volume, Other).
tasks.notes: Pipeline: Research 300 → Backtest all across 6 regimes (1yr M5) → First cull 300→100 (ExpR > +2.0, min 3 trades/month) → Walk-forward validation (second cull) → Build confidence engine → Deploy 20 Active + 10 Bench with monthly reviews. Key insight: ensemble of diverse agents beats single strategies; regime detection is the edge; most published strategies fail out-of-sample.

subtasks.title: M1: Strategy Research & Evidence Gathering
subtasks.description: Research and propose 300 evidence-based, diverse strategy concepts. Sources: GitHub, YouTube, X, academic papers. Each strategy gets an evidence score and diversity class. No strategy without evidence.
subtasks.notes: Diversity classes: Trend, Momentum, Breakout, Mean Reversion, Volatility, Volume/Order Flow, Other. Target: 300 unique strategies.
subtasks.nextAction: Build strategy research tracker. Begin populating from sources already found.

subtasks.title: M2: Backtest Harness Stabilization
subtasks.description: Fix the Lean backtest pipeline so it reliably produces canonical results. Parser must correctly extract SWARM_TRADE and SWARM_SUMMARY. Output paths unified. Margin-aware sizing prevents insufficient buying power errors.
subtasks.notes: Known issues fixed in risk_engine.py but need end-to-end verification.
subtasks.nextAction: Run 4-strategy smoke test across all 6 regimes.

subtasks.title: M3: First Cull — 300 to 100
subtasks.description: Run 1-year M5 backtest for all 300 strategies across all 6 regimes. Cull to 100: ExpR > +2.0, min 3 trades/month. Enforce diversity: min 10 per edge class.
subtasks.notes: This is a filter, not an optimization. Removed strategies are archived, not deleted.
subtasks.nextAction: After M2, begin coding and backtesting in batches of 50.

subtasks.title: M4: Walk-Forward Validation — Second Cull
subtasks.description: Walk-forward validation for 100 surviving strategies. Multiple unseen periods. Strategies that only work in one period get penalized. Average ExpR across folds becomes the true score.
subtasks.notes: Reference: arXiv 2512.12924. This separates real edges from overfitted noise.
subtasks.nextAction: Define walk-forward protocol. Implement in backtest runner.
activity: Walk-forward identified as second cull mechanism

subtasks.title: M5: Confidence Engine Construction
subtasks.description: All active strategies vote: bullish (+1), bearish (-1), neutral (0). Net confidence = sum of (strategy weight × signal direction). Weights from overall ExpR + regime-specific ExpR. No single strategy dominates.
subtasks.notes: Key: all strategies contribute, weights change per regime, engine aggregates signals.
subtasks.nextAction: Define confidence formula and weight calculation. Build prototype.
activity: Confidence engine architecture defined by Six

subtasks.title: M6: Meta-Regime Filter
subtasks.description: Circuit breaker above confidence engine. Check if ensemble has been profitable in current regime over rolling window. If negative → stay flat. Prevents trading in regimes where ALL strategies lose.
subtasks.notes: Simple version: rolling 30-day ensemble ExpR per regime.
subtasks.nextAction: After M5, add meta-regime filter layer.
evidence: Own backtest data showing regime-dependent performance
activity: Meta-Regime Filter concept approved by Six

subtasks.title: M7: Dynamic Lineup — 20 Active + 10 Bench
subtasks.description: Select 30 from walk-forward survivors: 20 Active + 10 Bench. Monthly review: bottom 5 demoted, top 5 promoted. Demotion: rolling ExpR negative, max drawdown exceeded.
subtasks.notes: Archived strategies can be re-evaluated. Bench is a proving ground.
subtasks.nextAction: Define promotion/demotion criteria.
activity: Dynamic Lineup concept defined by Six

subtasks.title: M8: Paper Trading & Forward Validation
subtasks.description: Deploy ensemble in paper trade mode. Monitor regime accuracy, confidence distribution, trade frequency, rolling ExpR. Minimum 3 months before live consideration.
subtasks.notes: If system cannot make money in paper trading, it will not make money live.
subtasks.nextAction: After M5+M6+M7, deploy paper trading.
activity: Paper trading identified as mandatory gate

subtasks.title: M9: Live Deployment
subtasks.description: Deploy with small size. Continuous monitoring. Risk limits enforced. Requires explicit Six approval after paper trade evidence.
subtasks.notes: Live trading is the beginning of real learning, not the end.
subtasks.nextAction: Requires: 3+ months paper trade evidence, Six approval.
